+ Ability to lift 35lbs
+ Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
+ Strong verbal and written communication skills
+ Works well independently, in a team, and in different environments
+ Experience in packaging lab testing is a plus but not required will train.

+ Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Physics, or STEM programs
+ Minimum 1 year of demonstrated expertise in a laboratory environment

+ Proven track record in packaging lab testing
